name: m34-long-text-ladder
description: M34 long-text ladder (spec Phase 15): one input per length rung, English call-center register. The 64/120/795-char rungs reuse existing benchmark texts verbatim (en-general-01, the pinned M3 bench sentence, m32-en-long-01); 500/1000/2000 are M34-authored extensions of the same register. Research instrument only.

cases.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog near the river bank.
IntelliAI turns text into natural speech. This fixed benchmark sentence measures synthesis latency and real time factor.
